pages.text: $(bold)War Scythe$()$(br2)Obtaining: craft it at the $(bold)Tinker Station$() — combining Broad Sword Blade / Small Sword Blade + Tough Handle + Tough Ring.$(br2)Features: a scythe rebuilt for combat, boasting $(bold)higher attack damage$() and a $(bold)larger attack range$() than its original version, along with a special attacking skill.

$(bold)Fever system$():$(li)every attack builds up Fever, and attack speed rises with your Fever$(li)attacking while holding a direction key consumes $(bold)20 Fever$() to blink$(li)when Fever is full (100), hold $(bold)W + Shift + Right Click$() to unleash the $(bold)Ultimate Slash$(): dealing 5 hits × 60% of your base damage$(br2)Your current Fever is shown on the tooltip.
